content: {"summary":"catalog-api-02 logged CAT‑E301 on 26 Oct 2025, indicating cache‑unavailable reads, while redis‑cache‑02.prod.internal returned LOADING for every lookup, meaning the cache was not yet ready to serve data.","likely_cause":"redis‑cache‑02 was still loading/not promoted as the primary after a failover or restart, so the cache was unavailable and catalog‑api fell back to catalog‑db, generating CAT‑E301 events.","confidence":"medium","claims":[{"text":"CAT‑E301 logs mean cache unavailable and reads fall back to catalog‑db","evidence_ids":["RB-017#1"],"quote":"catalog-api-01/02 logging `CAT-E301` (cache unavailable, reading through to catalog-db)"},{"text":"When the cache becomes reachable, CAT‑E301 drops to zero and catalog‑db CPU normalizes","evidence_ids":["RB-017#5"],"quote":"CAT-E301 is at zero, and catalog-db CPU is back to its usual range."},{"text":"Sentinel can be queried to confirm which host is the primary cache","evidence_ids":["RB-017#1"],"quote":"Ask Sentinel who the primary is."}],"next_checks":["Run `redis-cli -h redis-cache-02.prod.internal -p 26379 SENTINEL get-master-addr-by-name cache` to verify the current primary.","Check Redis INFO on redis‑cache‑02 for the LOADING flag and wait until it clears.","Monitor the CAT‑E301 rate in catalog‑api logs to see when it returns to zero.","Watch catalog‑db‑01 CPU usage for spikes while the cache is loading.","Run `redis-cli -h redis-cache-02.prod.internal -p 26379 SENTINEL CKQUORUM cache` to ensure Sentinel quorum is healthy."]}
